# Check if there is a tournament named "vernal ladies" with winning score 203 in September 2006
# First, filter for tournaments containing "vernal ladies" in the name
vernal_matches = df[df['tournament'].str.contains('vernal ladies', case=False, na=False)]

# Check if any of these matches have winning score 203 and date in September 2006
if not vernal_matches.empty:
    # Extract month and year from date column
    vernal_matches['date'] = pd.to_datetime(vernal_matches['date'], errors='coerce')
    month_match = vernal_matches['date'].dt.month == 9
    year_match = vernal_matches['date'].dt.year == 2006
    score_match = vernal_matches['winning score'].astype(str).str.contains('203')
    
    # Check if any row satisfies all conditions
    has_match = any(month_match & year_match & score_match)
else:
    has_match = False

answer = bool(has_match)
